api.hybrid_knowledge_search_1536 fuses exact, full-text, trigram, and ANN channels with reciprocal rank fusion. Requires a published vector-space version and a query embedding computed by the executor.
Unique per tenant on operation_intent and knowledge_batch. A second submit of the same bytes returns the existing receipt as duplicate_of.
A schemed external identifier. scheme is a closed check-constraint vocabulary. Unique per tenant on (scheme, value), so one identifier names at most one entity.
A durable proposed operation. knowledge-read-intent.v1 and knowledge-ingestion-intent.v1 are the workspace contracts; the ledger row is orchestration.operation_intent with an idempotency_key.
One committed admission transaction. commit_batch writes a knowledge_batch row with a receipt, idempotency key, and input digest, then advances the tenant head by one.
Per-tenant monotonic sequence of sealed knowledge batches. Every snapshot and ingestion intent cites it; begin_batch fails rebase_required when the expected head does not match.
When a fact was admitted or closed. Stamped from the open batch. Current rows have k_to null; closed rows keep history.
A precise selection inside a capture (text_quote, table, media_timecode, …) with selected_content_sha256. Support rows require a locator.
orchestration.mission is the durable work envelope. Intents and artifacts may record mission_id. Mission Control admission is out of band; this workspace only stores the id when supplied.
An entry in the knowledge-query-catalog. Agents pass a name and params; they never send SQL. Build validation executes each example under the catalog role.
A derived retrieval object (search_projection, vector_item) built from documents, records, or entities. Projection rebuilding is a governed runtime operation, not an agent write.
A published vector-space version that hybrid search is allowed to read. Unpublished or inactive versions raise insufficient_privilege.
Transaction failure (SQLSTATE 40001) from begin_batch when expected head does not match the locked knowledge_head. Not a per-proposal outcome.
Immutable orchestration.operation_receipt for one intent. Outcome is applied, rejected, noop, or partial. Facts and entities require a receipt id before they can be written.
taxonomy.relationship_kind.code with from_kinds, to_kinds, temporal flag, and property_schema. Trigger corpus.check_relationship_kinds rejects illegal endpoints.
Enabled on tenant tables. Typical policy km_tenant_access uses tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id(). Grants without a matching tenant context return no rows or fail closed.
NOLOGIN Postgres roles. app_reader sees api views and RPCs. pipeline_agent selects bounded schemas. executor_service alone executes temporal helpers and writes corpus facts.

Distinguishes parallel series on the same subject and stream kind (region, unit, episode). Default is the empty string. Part of the stream unique key; the database enforces no naming convention, so a correction must reuse the existing series key.
One assertion of a fact on a stream. Carries a world interval valid_during and a knowledge interval [k_from, k_to). Current means k_to is null.
An unresolved proposed identity. Not a staging copy of a fact. Resolution decisions are create, match, reject, or defer; vetting decisions are admit, reject, or defer.
The identity of a fact series, unique on (kind, subject entity or relationship, scope_key). Segments stack on a stream; overlapping current segments are forbidden.
temporal.stream_kind.code with subject_mode, subject_kinds, status_values, unit_values, requires_amount, and payload_schema. commit_batch validates slot rules.
A k-stamped link from a claim and locator to a segment or event occurrence. Written only through temporal.admit_support inside an open batch.
A question family with navigation, a read or ingestion operation, expected shape, and pitfalls. The shortest path from a natural-language question to a valid catalog query or intent.
Why the world interval is believed. explicit and carry_forward require an extent; observation_bounded is “true at capture time”; unresolved is an admitted gap.
Isolation key read from GUC app.tenant_id by util.current_tenant_id(). Missing context fails closed. RLS policies compare tenant_id to that function.
World time and knowledge time together. entity.at(entity, T, K) answers what was true at T as we knew it at K.

Allowed unit on an amount-bearing stream, listed in stream_kind.unit_values. For model_offering_price a new series defaults its scope_key to the unit so parallel price series do not collide; an existing series keeps whatever scope_key it has.
A named retrieval space (engineering_claims, entity_profiles, …) with versions and publications. Agents read only published versions; unpublished embeddings are invisible to hybrid search.
An evidence.verification_run that must be sealed before cited claims may be materialized. Ingestion refuses EVIDENCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE for unsealed or failing verdicts.
Allowlisted code tables such as taxonomy.entity_kind, taxonomy.relationship_kind, temporal.stream_kind, and identifier schemes. Slot rules and endpoint kinds are enforced at write time.
Generated projection of schema-ir.v1 into Markdown layers, search indexes, and the named-query catalog. Agents search then read a domain or task page; they never read schema-ir.json whole.
